boundary.zh: Pinhere v1 的完整 REST API，包含项目与 Origin、缺陷内容和状态流转、私有截图、Webhook 与投递诊断、PAT，以及 Chrome 扩展 OAuth 2.0 PKCE；共 34 个接口和 36 个 Schema。
boundary.en: The complete Pinhere v1 REST API for projects and origins, issue content and lifecycle transitions, private screenshots, webhooks and delivery diagnostics, PATs, and Chrome-extension OAuth 2.0 PKCE, comprising 34 Endpoints and 36 Schemas.

blockers.zh: pinhere.dev 当前未在 .dev 注册局注册，因此正式 API 与 https://pinhere.dev/.well-known/pontx.json 均不可达。公开 SDK 源码与 Node 18/20/22 CI 已就绪，但在 canonical 生产服务验证前不得发布 @pontx/pinhere 与 pontx-pinhere。
blockers.en: pinhere.dev is currently unregistered at the .dev registry, so the production API and https://pinhere.dev/.well-known/pontx.json are unreachable. The public SDK source and Node 18/20/22 CI are ready, but @pontx/pinhere and pontx-pinhere must not be published before the canonical production service is verified.

nextAction.zh: 注册 pinhere.dev，将其绑定到 jasonhzqs-projects/pinhere 的正式 Vercel 部署，并使发现地址返回与固定 source hash 一致的 PontxSpec；随后解除 SDK release gate，完成 npm registry 复验、正式 Metadata/Skill、Preview 与 Production 上线。生产 Hobby cron 当前仅每日 00:00 UTC 运行一次；除非计划升级，不得把五分钟自动重试描述为已上线能力。
nextAction.en: Register pinhere.dev, bind it to the production jasonhzqs-projects/pinhere Vercel deployment, and serve a PontxSpec matching the pinned source hash from the discovery URL. Then clear the SDK release gate and complete npm registry verification, admitted Metadata/Skill, Preview, and Production rollout. The production Hobby cron currently runs only once daily at 00:00 UTC; do not describe five-minute automatic retries as deployed unless the plan is upgraded.
